title: Technology Sector Update for 10/30/2018: AKAM,SNE,RMBS
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT -2.73%
AAPL +0.12%
IBM -2.65%
CSCO +0.36%
GOOG -0.15%
Technology stocks were higher in recent trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 climbing almost 0.4% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Akamai ( AKAM ) climbed 16% on Tuesday after Suntrust raised its investment rating on the cloud-services company and RBC Capital Markets and B. Riley increased their price targets on Akamai shares after the company reported above-consensus Q3 financial results and authorized a new stock buyback program for up to $1.1 billion.
In other sector news:
(+) Sony ( SNE ) climbed about 7.5% at one point Tuesday after reporting better-than-expected fiscal Q2 financial results and boosting its FY19 earnings and sales outlook.
(-) Rambus ( RMBS ) fell 6.6%. The chipmaker reported better-than-expected Q3 earnings and named Luc Seraphin as its permanent chief executive officer.
